newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POLIFARB DEBICA STARTS BOURSE TRADE AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POLIFARB DEBICA STARTS BOURSE TRADE AUG 12.

text.p: Polish paint maker Polifarb Debica SA, 32-percent owned by Swedish Alcro-Beckers AB, will start trade on the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse on August 12, the bourse said in a statement on Tuesday.
The company's February initial public offering of 0.7 million shares at 65 zlotys each was heavily oversubscribed.
Last month the Swedish firm, then holding a 0.3-percent stake in Polifarb, called a public tender offer to buy the remaining 2,029,436 shares at 89 zlotys from July 25-August 22.
